commerce_item_money.name: commerce_item_money
commerce_item_money.value: "commerce_order_items"."quantity" between 1 and 1000 and "commerce_order_items"."line_cents"="commerce_order_items"."quantity"*"commerce_order_items"."price_cents" and "commerce_order_items"."refunded_cents" between 0 and "commerce_order_items"."line_cents"

commerce_alert_lifecycle.name: commerce_alert_lifecycle
commerce_alert_lifecycle.value:
"commerce_alert_incidents"."first_detected_at"<="commerce_alert_incidents"."last_seen_at" and "commerce_alert_incidents"."first_detected_at"<="commerce_alert_incidents"."last_transition_at" and
      (("commerce_alert_incidents"."state"='pending' and "commerce_alert_incidents"."opened_at" is null and "commerce_alert_incidents"."resolved_at" is null) or
       ("commerce_alert_incidents"."state"='open' and "commerce_alert_incidents"."opened_at" is not null and "commerce_alert_incidents"."resolved_at" is null) or
       ("commerce_alert_incidents"."state"='resolved' and "commerce_alert_incidents"."resolved_at" is not null))

commerce_alert_email_lifecycle.name: commerce_alert_email_lifecycle
commerce_alert_email_lifecycle.value:
(("commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."state"='pending' and "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."claim_token" is null and "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."attempted_at" is null and "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."completed_at" is null)
    or ("commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."state"='submitting' and "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."claim_token" is not null and "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."attempted_at" is not null and "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."completed_at" is null)
    or ("commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."state" in ('accepted','simulated') and "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."claim_token" is not null and "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."attempted_at" is not null and "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."completed_at" is not null and coalesce(length("commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."provider_id"),0)>0)
    or ("commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."state" in ('needs_review','skipped_resolved') and "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."completed_at" is not null and "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."reason_code" is not null))
    and ("commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."state"<>'accepted' or "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."mode"='resend') and ("commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."state"<>'simulated' or "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."mode"='mock')
    and ("commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."completed_at" is null or "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."completed_at">="commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."created_at")

commerce_alert_email_times.name: commerce_alert_email_times
commerce_alert_email_times.value: ("commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."attempted_at" is null or "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."attempted_at">="commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."created_at") and ("commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."completed_at" is null or "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."attempted_at" is null or "commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."completed_at">="commerce_alert_email_deliveries"."attempted_at")
